roles.title: Director of Product Management, Advertiser Platform
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: Define the vision for an AI-first Ads Manager and the Moloco Ads MCP, and build a roadmap by advertiser job: campaign creation, creative operations, reporting and optimization.
Take the first Ads Manager agents from beta to general availability, and phase in MCP write actions with Growth Managers using each phase before advertisers do.
Keep Ads Manager and the MCP at parity: when a workflow launches in one, commit to a date for the other.
Make agents safe to trust. Each workflow moves from recommendation to approval to delegation within limits, and every agent action is explained, logged and reversible.
Build on the shared platform rather than a second version, and return anything reusable across advertisers and employees to it.

roles.title: Director of Product Management, CTV
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: Deliver advertiser experiences that matter: Understand what CTV advertisers need and where they get stuck, then lead teams to build intuitive, indispensable products.
Drive measurable business growth: Own business outcomes such as ad spend, share of wallet, and advertiser performance.
Lead innovation in the market: Spot new opportunities and technical advances in CTV, and keep Moloco ahead of the competition.
Influence across the organization: Be a key voice for the advertiser with leaders across engineering, data science, sales, and marketing, and rally the resources this business…

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Ads Quality and Performance - Moloco Commerce Media

bullets: 10+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a domain end to end, from strategy through shipped, measured outcomes. You are ready to operate as the senior…
Depth in ads quality, ML-driven ranking, bidding, or recommender systems. Large-scale ads ranking, adtech, and commerce search and recommendation are the most direct backgrounds.
Enough technical fluency to earn credibility with ML and data science teams: you help shape the problem framing and stakeholder translation, and contribute points of view on…
Rigor on measurement. You can define outcome metrics and keep proxy metrics from quietly becoming the goal.
Executive communication and the standing to move senior stakeholders across product, engineering, and customer teams.
